capabilities: pull NoteAlong notes into a chosen vault folder as Markdown files with images and properties
sync on startup, on a timer, via a command or a ribbon button
protect user edits such as the My notes section, added properties and Spaced Repetition review data
export transcripts, flashcards in Spaced Repetition format and language versions of notes
track renames, deletions and conflicts between the vault and NoteAlong
extras: The plugin is free with no ads or telemetry; NoteAlong itself has a free plan and a paid plan, and creating new notes beyond the free monthly allowance needs the paid plan. The README includes detailed network-use, data-fetched and credentials disclosures, and notes the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: NoteAlong notes live in an outside service, so there is no way to work with them in Obsidian as local Markdown files.

relations.evidence: This plugin pulls those notes into a folder of your vault as plain Markdown files
With the BRAT plugin, choose Add a beta plugin for testing

summary: Syncs NoteAlong lecture notes, flashcards and transcripts into a vault folder as Markdown files, while preserving edits made in Obsidian.
